name: Valley of Trials
summary: The Valley of Trials, in the south of Durotar, is where young orcs and Darkspear trolls are put to the test. Chieftains and trainers watch over them from The Den, a shelter cut into the cliffs. Out in the sunlit gulch, the recruits hunt scorpids and cull the angry boars. They keep the lazy peons in line as well, while they gather the valley's scarce timber.

sections.title: A Crucible of Sand and Stone
sections.body: The trial is hard. Only those who prove their mettle earn the right to leave as soldiers of the Horde, ready to defend their people. Those who fail are left beneath the desert sun.

sections.title: The Shadow in the North
sections.body: The northern caves have brought a new danger to the Valley of Trials. Cultists of the Burning Blade have settled in the natural caves along the cliffs and summon minor demonic familiars into the valley. Trainers use the intruders to give fresh recruits live combat practice. But fel magic so close to Orgrimmar’s threshold fuels rumors that the Shadow Council is trying to regain its hold over the orcish people.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Valley of Trials?
faq.answer: The Valley of Trials is where young orcs and Darkspear trolls prove themselves to the Horde. In its sheltered canyons, recruits face demanding trials of martial skill, survival, and loyalty before they may leave for the rest of Durotar.

The Den is a cave carved into the cliffs near the center of the valley. Class trainers, vendors, and overseers such as Gornek gather there to direct, equip, and watch over new recruits during their first trials.

faq.q: Why are there demons in a beginner's training ground?
aliases: why demons in valley of trials
faq.answer: Cultists of the Burning Blade have taken root in the northern caves and summon weak demonic familiars. Trainers use the familiars to test recruits, while the cult’s presence suggests the Shadow Council is seeking a foothold on Durotar’s doorstep.

Sarkoth is an unusually large, venomous scorpid that lives in the rocky heights of the valley. Instructors send promising recruits to hunt him, testing their courage and asking them to bring back his mangled claw as proof.

angles.text: For a young orc seeking honor, the valley is a rite of passage that carries on Draenor’s warrior traditions in a newly forged homeland.
After losing their home on the Echo Isles to Zalazane, Darkspear trolls train beside their orc allies in this canyon to earn their place in the Horde.
